name: DeFi TVL rise + stablecoin ETH-share rise -> stable-deposit demand long (ETH)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the TVL-vs-price residual variant: this cross-confirms TVL growth with stablecoin_eth_share rising — the CLEANEST non-beta component of TVL, because stablecoin deposits are dollar-denominated and do NOT mechanically inflate with ETH price; a TVL rise that coincides with more stablecoins concentrating on ETH is deposit-driven, not price-driven): the leakage trap in raw TVL is the ETH-denominated portion. Requiring stablecoin_eth_share to rise alongside defi_tvl isolates the dollar-deposit inflow that genuinely leads ETH demand (RWA + stablecoin inflows hitting $17B in 2025). Long ETH when both confirm; exit on share rolling over or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if removing stablecoin_eth_share leaves the result unchanged, the de-beta'd cross-confirm adds nothing and it is disguised beta again. DISCONFIRMER 2: eth_share history may be short/revised -> verify PIT coverage; KILL if the edge depends on revised data. DISCONFIRMER 3: if a plain TVL-growth long matches the deflated Sharpe, the share leg is redundant. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: stablecoin-denominated TVL deposits concentrating on ETH
